superpowers.note: Every checked claim held (51 Line literals, help-toggle intercept ordering, slide/JSON early returns, toast always prefixing a check mark) and failure paths are tabulated, though the new warning-toast theme color is scope creep.

plain.note: Pending-key check sits in handle_normal, which runs after is_help_toggle, so m then h or ? would open help instead of setting a mark; save also prunes missing files, contradicting its own tradeoffs.

feature-dev.note: Correctly places the pending key before the help toggle and handles slide mode and a corrupt store, but falls back to ~/.local/state on macOS, splitting config and marks across trees.

code-design.note: Adding ViewMode::Mark and extending accepts_text_input neatly avoids the help-toggle conflict, with full signatures and numbered call chains, but slide mode behavior is left implicit.

reason: W's claims about the existing code all checked out and it designs the subtle interactions explicitly (help-toggle ordering, lazy list-item flush, slide/JSON/stdin disabling, healing, corrupt and newer-version store), leaving few surprises for the implementer. Z is the best structured and most reviewable via signatures and call chains, and Y is close behind, while X misses the is_help_toggle interception, a real bug in its key flow.
